summary: Frontend-only regression completed on public preview URL. Requested pricing/pro-gate/responsive/ad-placeholder/mobile usability flows pass, with one logic bug in Search Intent classification heuristics.

integration_issues.issue: Informational query containing 'topical' is misclassified as Commercial because regex '/top/' matches substring 'top' in 'topical'.

action_items: Fix intent regex to avoid substring false positives (e.g., use word boundaries for 'top', 'best', etc.).
Re-run intent classifier regression specifically with mixed informational/commercial terms such as 'what is topical authority'.
critical_code_review_comments: App.jsx is 925 lines (>700 guideline); split into smaller focused components/modules to reduce regression risk.
Intent classifier pattern order and regex granularity causes semantic misclassification in realistic queries.
test_credentials: Not used (frontend-only scope). /app/memory/test_credentials.md is present but effectively empty.
seed_data_creation: Used localStorage UI flows: synthlabs_pro_access toggled during gate tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: Pricing nav from desktop header, mobile drawer, and footer; pricing plans ($0 and $9/month) and disclaimer; no horizontal overflow at 320/390/768/desktop across pricing/home/tools/pro workspace; Pro tabs locked when access absent; activation/open/reset flows; Topical mapper (hub + 4 clusters); Entity auditor (score/found/missing); ad placeholders by breakpoint; mobile drawer (6 items, closes on pricing); sampled touch targets >=44px; existing free tools/support/theme/beta/agency flows. Remaining bug is intent misclassification edge due regex.
rca of the issue: Repro: Activate Pro -> Tools -> Search Intent tab -> input multiline query including 'what is topical authority'. Observed classification = Commercial, expected = Informational in natural-language intent context. Root cause: classify() checks '/best|top|review|.../' where 'top' matches inside 'topical'. Mitigation: tighten regex with word boundaries (e.g., \btop\b) and/or prioritize question-form patterns ('what/how/why') before commercial heuristics.
